title: Mexican Pastry Pinwheels
description: A delicious and easy-to-make pastry pinwheel recipe filled with yummy Greek cheese and paired perfectly with a tangy sauce. This recipe is a great twist on traditional Mexican cuisine.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Roll out the phillo pastry sheets to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch (6mm) thick.
3. In a bowl, mix together the crumbled feta cheese, chopped spinach, thinly sliced red onion (if using), and minced garlic.
4. Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch (2.5cm) border on either side.
5. Brush the edges of the pastry with olive oil.
6. Roll the pastry into a tight log, starting from one of the long edges.
7. Cut the log into 1-inch (2.5cm) thick slices.
8. Place the pinwheels on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch (2.5cm) of space between each pinwheel.
9. Brush the tops of the pinwheels with a little more olive oil.
10. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
11. Serve warm with a side of tangy sauce for dipping.
